<!--
  The order history as a table or as cards: number, date, items, total and a status pill, with an optional
  pager. Axes: layout (table, cards), pager (show, hide), tone, density.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Order, OrderLabels } from "./order-table.types";

  export type OrderTableProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    orders: Order[];
    statuses: Record<string, string>;
    labels: OrderLabels;
    layout?: "table" | "cards";
    pager?: "show" | "hide";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    density?: "default" | "compact";
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Card from "../primitives/card/card.svelte";
  import CardContent from "../primitives/card/card-content.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import OrderRows from "../components/order-rows.svelte";
  import Pager from "../components/pager.svelte";
  import Pill from "../components/pill.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { at, fmtMoney, tpl } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    orders,
    statuses,
    labels,
    layout = "table",
    pager = "show",
    tone = "default",
    density = "default",
  }: OrderTableProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame id={id} title={title} tone={tone} density={density}>
  <Stack gap="4" align="stretch">
    {#if ((layout as string) === "table")}
      <OrderRows orders={orders} statuses={statuses} labels={labels} density={density} />
    {:else}
      <Stack gap="4" align="stretch" data-testid="order-cards">
        {#each orders as o (o.id)}
          <Card variant="default" data-testid="item">
            <CardContent class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
              <Stack gap="0">
                <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
                  {o.number}
                </Text>
                <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
                  {o.date}
                </Text>
              </Stack>
              <Text size="sm">
                {tpl(labels.itemsCount, o.items)}
              </Text>
              <Text size="sm" weight="bold">
                {fmtMoney(o.total, o.currency)}
              </Text>
              <Pill
                tone={
                  o.status === "paid" ? "green"
                  : o.status === "shipped" ? "blue"
                  : o.status === "pending" ? "amber"
                  : "gray"
                }
              >
                {at(statuses, o.status)}
              </Pill>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        {/each}
      </Stack>
    {/if}
    {#if ((pager as string) === "show")}
      <Pager
        page={1}
        pages={3}
        summary={tpl(labels.summary, 1, 4, 12)}
        previousLabel={labels.previous}
        nextLabel={labels.next}
      />
    {/if}
  </Stack>
</SectionFrame>
